name: Del Amo Fashion Center
description: Del Amo Fashion Center is one of the largest shopping destinations in the United States, featuring an expansive collection of premier retailers, dining experiences, and entertainment options. This iconic Southern California mall offers shoppers a world-class retail experience with major department store anchors and hundreds of specialty shops spread across its massive enclosed complex.
summary: One of America's largest shopping malls offering premier retail, dining, and entertainment under one roof in the South Bay area of Los Angeles.
